text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: father noun governed by the opening vocative

words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) makes the ayah begin in direct address, so the coming correction is spoken to the father rather than about him. The call governs {{ar:أَبَتِ}} ({{tr:abati}}) and opens the appeal -> knowledge claim -> command -> guidance promise chain. Its elongated onset also slows the first beat before the argument becomes urgent.

topics.headline: direct address before argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the correction begin as a direct appeal to the father before it becomes proof, command, or promise.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the particle govern the father noun, and the CRITICAL rows show that the opening call frames the whole chain.

topics.headline: drawn opening softens urgency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the onset slowed by the call before the command sequence tightens.
topics.reason: The phonetic row concerns the surface call contour, while grammar keeps the word a vocative particle.

words.gloss_range: intimate singular vocative for the father as addressee
words.root_gloss_range: fatherhood, paternal origin, and kinship authority; refusal-related material is only a narrowed resonance here
words.prose: {{ar:أَبَتِ}} ({{tr:abati}}) identifies the father as a directly addressed person, not a narrated subject. The intimate vocative form lets Ibrāhīm make a severe knowledge claim without dropping filial softness, and the repeated father-addresses around the passage (19:42; 19:44; 19:45; 19:46) make that tenderness cumulative. The same filial address also contrasts with receptive father scenes (12:4; 12:100) and with lineage defense in 19:28, so this address keeps filial language while reversing spiritual direction. At the same time, the word sharpens the authority reversal: the father who normally stands as origin is about to be asked to follow the son. Refusal-related root pressure may be heard as irony, but the local lexical sense remains fatherhood.

topics.headline: known father is addressed, not narrated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps one known father as the addressee across the knowledge gap, command, and promise.
topics.reason: The vocative noun is singular and governed by the call particle, so the father is addressed as recipient rather than clause subject.

topics.headline: affectionate form carries severe claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that filial tenderness remains audible while the argument grows sharper across the repeated father-addresses (19:42; 19:44; 19:45; 19:46).
topics.reason: The intimate vocative form and same-surah repetitions support tenderness without changing the referent.

topics.headline: fatherly authority is reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the son addressing the originating family authority while asking that father to become the follower.
topics.reason: The later imperative targets the same father, turning expected ancestral following into receptivity to the son.

topics.headline: refusal shadow is only a resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register an ironic refusal-shadow around the father address while keeping fatherhood as the local meaning.
topics.reason: The local surface names fatherhood; related refusal material may color the scene but cannot replace the vocative noun sense.

topics.headline: filial address is redirected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares this filial address with receptive or lineage scenes (12:4; 12:100; 19:28) and notices that 19:43 reverses the direction of guidance.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete parallels where father-language frames lineage or reception, while 19:43 uses it for correction.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle with first-person suffix asserting personal testimony
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّي}} ({{tr:innī}}) fuses emphasis with the first-person speaker, so the claim is self-attested from the start. The word does not merely introduce information; it commits Ibrāhīm to the knowledge-arrival premise that will justify the command. Its scope holds the disclosure, the father’s non-reception, and the command-promise sequence inside one live address.

topics.headline: speaker binds himself to the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the later command resting on the speaker’s asserted personal access, not on a tentative suggestion.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle and first-person suffix form a self-attested assertion that precedes the imperative.

topics.headline: claim governs the remaining chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the knowledge arrival, father’s non-reception, command, and promise inside one asserted frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the assertion clause govern the predicate chain and result clauses.

topics.headline: narrative gives way to direct speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the father’s correction as live dialogue rather than distant report.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent with the direct-address syntax at the start of the ayah.

words.gloss_range: certainty and completion particle before a perfect verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: perfect arrival verb whose completion is marked by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) gives the knowledge-arrival premise completed weight before {{ar:جَاءَنِي}} ({{tr:jāʾanī}}). The father is not being asked to respond to speculation; the command will rest on something presented as already realized. At the boundary, the critique of the idol’s failure turns into a positive offer of knowledge.

topics.headline: arrival is treated as accomplished
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command grounded in knowledge already received, not in a possible future claim.
topics.reason: The certainty/completion particle stands before a perfect verb and gives the premise accomplished force.

topics.headline: the speech turns from critique to proposal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from exposing the idol’s failure to offering a positive source of guidance.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the shift from the previous idol critique into the knowledge claim.

words.gloss_range: perfect arrival verb with first-person object suffix, presenting knowledge as having reached the speaker
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, reaching; here abstract knowledge is treated as an arriving event

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative pronoun carrying the unnamed knowledge-content
negated non-arrival clause contrasting the completed arrival

words.prose: {{ar:جَاءَنِي}} ({{tr:jāʾanī}}) makes knowledge an arrival-event that lands on Ibrāhīm through the first-person suffix. The source is not named, so the focus stays on reception and consequence rather than self-manufactured authority. The relative {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the content as whatever has come, not a named doctrine or explicit object. Its completed perfect form contrasts with {{ar:لَمْ يَأْتِكَ}} ({{tr:lam yāʾtika}}): what reached the son did not reach the father. The wording also draws a knowledge-arrival formula into family dialogue, with parallels where received knowledge demands response (13:37; 2:120; 2:145) and same-surah contrasts where arrival carries accusation or enormity (19:27; 19:89).

topics.headline: knowledge comes to the speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures knowledge as an event that reached Ibrāhīm, not as status he manufactured for himself.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I verb with first-person object suffix presents reception, while the sender remains unspoken.

topics.headline: completed reception contrasts non-reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speaker-father gap mapped through two coming verbs: completed arrival to Ibrāhīm and denied arrival to the father.
topics.reason: The morphology contrasts completed arrival for the speaker with lam-governed non-arrival for the father.

topics.headline: unnamed content is the arriving subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the content remains unnamed while local syntax makes it the thing that came, not a manufactured object.
topics.reason: The row preserves the relative-pronoun content point, but attachment evidence identifies the relative pronoun as subject of the arrival verb rather than a direct object.

topics.headline: corpus form supports completion only locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep the completed-past force without turning a corpus distribution statistic into an independent doctrine.
topics.reason: The local verb is perfect; the broader claim about all root occurrences is background and does not add a separate local sense.

topics.headline: revelatory knowledge formula enters family dialogue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a Quranic knowledge-arrival pattern brought into Ibrāhīm’s appeal to his father, with concrete parallels and contrasts (13:37; 2:120; 2:145; 25:29; 19:27; 19:89).
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete parallels where knowledge comes and demands response; 19:43 turns that warning register into invitation.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking source, partitive scope, and specification before the knowledge noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite knowledge noun governed by the partitive preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) governs {{ar:الْعِلْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿilmi}}) and keeps the claim measured: something came from the knowledge-domain, not all knowledge without limit. Because the phrase comes before the relative clause, the quality of the received matter is established before the father’s non-reception is named. Authority and restraint are compressed into one preposition.

topics.headline: from knowledge means portion, source, and kind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Ibrāhīm claiming enough received knowledge to guide while avoiding a claim to total knowledge.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following genitive knowledge noun and precedes the relative gap clause, giving the claim partitive and source force.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive verbal noun naming the knowledge-domain after the partitive preposition
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, certain cognizance, signs, landmarks, and orientation; here a measured received portion is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: promised path phrase formed by noun and adjective

words.prose: {{ar:الْعِلْمِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿilmi}}) is definite, but the surrounding phrase keeps the portion unspecified. The word gives Ibrāhīm’s claim a known domain rather than total possession. Because the root-field links knowledge with signs and orientation, the later promise of {{ar:صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭan sawiyyā}}) is not a new theme but the route-form of received knowledge. Cross-references to limited bestowed knowledge (17:85; 21:74; 28:14), Maryam’s messenger-reception scene (19:19), and warnings about following without knowledge (28:50; 10:89; 6:148) make the imperative a knowledge-based response.

topics.headline: knowledge is a known domain, not total possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge is treated as an identifiable domain from which a portion came.
topics.reason: The definite verbal noun stands in a partitive prepositional phrase, supplying category without exhaustive content.

topics.headline: knowing becomes guidance orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why knowledge can lead naturally into a path promise: it is certain orientation rather than mere opinion.
topics.reason: The root-family rows connect knowing with signs and landmarks, supporting the move from knowledge to route.

topics.headline: received knowledge authorizes following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the call to follow as grounded in received knowledge, with limited-bestowal and anti-desire parallels (17:85; 21:74; 28:14; 28:50; 10:89; 6:148; 19:19).
topics.reason: The rows link knowledge with coming, giving, and following; locally the knowledge gap authorizes the imperative rather than social rank alone.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun carrying unnamed knowledge-content across two clauses
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the received content unnamed while binding the two halves of the contrast. It is the thing that came to Ibrāhīm and the same thing that did not come to the father. That compact hinge keeps the argument focused on differential access and urgent guidance, not on listing the doctrine in this word. Across the boundary, the same small word shifts from idol thingness to guidance-content, replacing a false object with what should now be followed.

topics.headline: one unnamed content spans arrival and non-arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same unnamed knowledge-content linking what came to Ibrāhīm and what did not come to the father.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun functions across the arrival and non-arrival clauses, keeping attention on access rather than content listing.

topics.headline: same small word changes load across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an earlier thing-word for the idol is replaced by a content-word for true guidance.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent as discourse contrast, while local grammar keeps this occurrence as a relative pronoun.

words.gloss_range: jussive negation particle denying arrival up to the present

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following verb governed by the negation particle

words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs {{ar:يَأْتِكَ}} ({{tr:yāʾtika}}) and makes the father’s non-reception grammatically complete. The claim is not that knowledge may come later in the same way; it has not reached him up to this point. The negation marks an epistemic deficit that explains the command, while the father remains the addressed recipient of the coming guidance promise.

topics.headline: negation makes non-reception complete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the father’s lack as something that has not occurred up to this point, not merely as delayed knowledge.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following imperfect and turns it into perfective negation.

topics.headline: lack explains the command without attacking the father
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the father as the same addressee who lacks reception, receives the command, and is offered guidance.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the arrival verb, while the second-person chain keeps the father as target rather than source of the lack.

words.gloss_range: lam-governed imperfect/jussive arrival verb with second-person object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: coming, reaching, arriving; bestowal resonance from related forms is narrowed and not the local parse

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive negation particle governing the non-arrival verb
completed arrival verb contrasted with the father's non-arrival

words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِكَ}} ({{tr:yāʾtika}}) names the father as the endpoint that knowledge did not reach. Under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), the imperfect is blocked as a completed non-arrival, contrasting with {{ar:جَاءَنِي}} ({{tr:jāʾanī}}), the completed arrival to Ibrāhīm. The contrast is between two arrival roots, not one repeated root, so the asymmetry survives with that correction. A bestowal resonance can be heard from the broader root family, but the local parse is coming-to-you, not a Form IV giving verb. Inter-ayah rows make the public question of what did not come to fathers (23:68) intimate in the address to one father, and guidance-coming formulas link arrival to following and guidance (20:123; 28:49).

topics.headline: knowledge did not reach the father
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the father as the endpoint that knowledge has not reached, which grounds the need to follow.
topics.reason: The lam-governed imperfect is jussive, and the second-person suffix marks the father as the unrealized recipient.

topics.headline: two coming verbs map unequal access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the internal contrast between completed coming to Ibrāhīm and denied coming to the father.
topics.reason: The two roots are near-synonymous in the local contrast, with different morphology and polarity.

topics.headline: non-arrival may suggest non-bestowal, but not as the parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear bestowal pressure around the root family, while the local surface remains coming-to-you under negation.
topics.reason: QAC and local syntax support Form I coming; Form IV giving is a root-family resonance, not the governing local parse.

topics.headline: father-address makes a public formula intimate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the knowledge-arrival formula and ancestor-novelty question made personal in one father-address (23:68; 20:123; 28:49).
topics.reason: The supplied references link knowledge, coming, guidance, and following; 19:43 applies that logic to the father directly.

topics.headline: the contrast is not the same root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the local contrast between the two arrival verbs while correcting the row’s same-root overstatement.
topics.reason: Word 5 is aligned to root j-y-ʾ and word 10 to root ʾ-t-y, so the row’s contrast survives but its same-root wording is corrected.

words.gloss_range: consequential conjunction attached to the imperative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperative command joined to the consequential particle

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge where the premise becomes action. Because knowledge came to Ibrāhīm and did not reach the father, the next move is not passive acknowledgment but {{ar:اتَّبِعْنِي}} ({{tr:ittabiʿnī}}). The particle is attached directly to the command, so the logic chain remains tight: claim -> command -> guidance promise.

topics.headline: premise becomes command immediately
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the knowledge differential converted into an immediate practical demand, not left as information.
topics.reason: The conjunction is attached to the imperative and links the completed knowledge claim to the command as consequence.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII imperative with first-person object suffix: follow me
words.root_gloss_range: following, tracking, pursuing, adhering; here active chosen alignment behind the speaker
words.prose: {{ar:اتَّبِعْنِي}} ({{tr:ittabiʿnī}}) is the pivot of the speech. The imperative turns the knowledge gap into action, and the suffix makes Ibrāhīm himself the object of following. The root’s tracking sense keeps the command embodied: the father is asked to align and move behind a guide. The command also belongs to a wider command-guidance formula, with echoes such as 40:38 and 20:90, while knowledge-and-following warnings (13:37; 2:145) show why this following is epistemic obedience rather than family deference alone. Against the prior service of what cannot hear or help, the command redirects the father from idol-service into deliberate guided adherence.

topics.headline: the father is commanded to follow the speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the knowledge gap become an embodied command to follow Ibrāhīm himself, not an abstract principle alone.
topics.reason: The imperative and first-person object suffix are fused in one word, making the speaker the explicit object of following.

topics.headline: following means chosen alignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command asks for active alignment and movement behind a guide, not mere mental agreement.
topics.reason: The root field supports tracking and adherence, and Form VIII gives the command volitional force.

topics.headline: following joins guidance in a known formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command as part of a command-guidance pattern, with concrete echoes and contrasts (40:38; 20:90; 13:37; 2:145; 20:47).
topics.reason: The rows connect following with guidance, faith, and knowledge, while local syntax puts the formula in Ibrāhīm’s address to his father.

topics.headline: failed service is redirected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the father’s relation to a powerless object replaced by guided adherence to the knowledgeable speaker.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the prior idol critique and the present imperative.

words.root_display: {{ar:ه د د}} ({{tr:h-d-d}}), with local guidance sense from {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}})
words.gloss_range: first-person guidance verb with second-person object, tied as result of following

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperative on which the guidance promise depends
path object supplied by the guidance verb
QAC-assigned root retained as a data tension
guidance root selected by local sense and valency

words.prose: {{ar:أَهْدِكَ}} ({{tr:ahdika}}) is the promised result of {{ar:اتَّبِعْنِي}} ({{tr:ittabiʿnī}}): follow me, and I will guide you. Its valency is personal and directional, with the father as object and {{ar:صِرَاطًا}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭan}}) as the path-object. The QAC root assignment points to {{ar:ه د د}} ({{tr:h-d-d}}), but the local sense and construction select guidance from {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}), so demolition is not activated as the word’s meaning. The son’s guide-role reverses family authority while preserving the offer as a gift-like benefit rather than coercion. The command-guidance formula is echoed at 40:38, while path-guidance and path-quality parallels keep the destination frame visible (1:6; 21:73; 64:6).

topics.headline: guidance takes person and path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees guidance as personal direction toward a route, not mere information transfer.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the father suffix as one object and the path noun as the explicit object complement.

topics.headline: guidance depends on following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is grammatically contingent: following is the condition under which guidance is offered.
topics.reason: The guidance clause follows the imperative as its result, so it is not an unconditional outcome.

topics.headline: QAC root conflict is preserved but limited
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids a false demolition reading while keeping the data tension visible for lexical review.
topics.reason: The bundle itself says QAC assigns h-d-d while semantic content is h-d-y guidance; local valency and path object select guidance.

topics.headline: son offers guidance as benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the familial inversion as a generous offer: the son takes the guide role toward the father without coercing him.
topics.reason: The first-person subject is implicit in the verb, the father is the object, and the guidance root family supports offered benefit.

topics.headline: command-guidance becomes a destination formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the follow-me guide-you pair in a larger formulaic field (40:38; 1:6; 21:73; 64:6) while keeping 19:43 personal and familial.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete parallels for following, guidance, and path quality; local syntax keeps them in a father-son appeal.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative path noun as the explicit object complement of guidance
words.root_gloss_range: road, path, route, and guidance-way; sibilant or swallowing imagery is narrowed to variant texture

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final adjective completing the path phrase

words.prose: {{ar:صِرَاطًا}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭan}}) gives the promise a route. It is not a loose adjunct after guidance; it is the path-object to which the father may be guided. Its indefiniteness makes the offer particular in this speech rather than simply the fixed definite formula of 1:6. The noun remains open until {{ar:سَوِيًّا}} ({{tr:sawiyyā}}) completes it, so the closing promise is not merely a path but an even, balanced, sound path; that quality contrasts upright-straight formulas and joins same-root wholeness markers (38:22; 67:22; 19:10; 19:17; 19:36). Variant sibilant pressure can enrich the word’s texture by suggesting a route that absorbs the traveler, but the local role remains stable.

topics.headline: a path, not the fixed definite formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the modest, particular offer of a path in this argument rather than a direct reuse of the definite formula (1:6).
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite with tanwin, while the row contrasts it with the definite path formula.

topics.headline: guidance becomes a traversable route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promised guidance take shape as a route reached through following and evaluated at the close.
topics.reason: The path noun is the explicit object complement of the guidance verb and is modified by the final adjective.

topics.headline: variant sound enriches the path image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may register the sibilant or swallowing image as variant-sensitive texture while the local syntax remains stable.
topics.reason: The variant rows affect sound and imagery, but they do not change the local noun’s syntactic role as path object.

topics.headline: the path waits for its final quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits for the final adjective to learn that the promised route is marked by evenness, balance, and soundness rather than only upright straightness (38:22; 67:22; 19:10; 19:17; 19:36).
topics.reason: The noun is structurally completed by the following adjective, and the supplied rows contrast this path quality with other formulas.

words.gloss_range: accusative indefinite adjective qualifying the path at the ayah close
words.root_gloss_range: even, level, balanced, proportionate, sound, whole, and complete; here these qualify the promised path

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: path noun modified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:سَوِيًّا}} ({{tr:sawiyyā}}) locks onto {{ar:صِرَاطًا}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭan}}) by agreement, so the final word specifically qualifies the promised path. It makes the route level enough to walk, balanced enough to correct the father’s position, and sound or whole enough to answer the knowledge imbalance. The choice is not merely a synonym for upright-straight formulas; it stresses equilibrium and proportion, with parallels where the same root marks soundness, meeting-place evenness, or path-rightness (19:10; 19:17; 20:58; 38:22; 67:22). It also answers the condemned loss of the even way (5:12; 2:108; 5:77; 60:1) and the knowledge-balance tests (39:9; 16:75). The paired accusative endings give the promise a balanced close that matches the meaning.

topics.headline: final adjective belongs to the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word as a locked adjective for the promised path, not as a floating adverb or general moral slogan.
topics.reason: Agreement and matching tanwin bind the adjective to the path noun and close the phrase sonically.

topics.headline: evenness becomes the promised quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the path as walkable, balanced, proportionate, and whole at once.
topics.reason: The lexical rows preserve levelness, proportion, soundness, and completion as the adjective’s positive local payoff.

topics.headline: balance differs from upright straightness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the even-balanced path from upright-straight path formulas, with concrete contrasts (20:58; 38:22; 67:22; 5:12; 2:108; 5:77; 60:1).
topics.reason: The rows contrast the selected adjective with other path-quality descriptors and with straying from the even way.

topics.headline: knowledge imbalance resolves as balance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the unequal knowledge relation answered by a promise of wholeness and balance, with same-surah markers (19:10; 19:17) and knowledge-balance tests (39:9; 16:75).
topics.reason: The supplied echoes tie the root to wholeness and equality; locally the path adjective closes the knowledge-gap argument.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from knowledge arriving only to the speaker through following, guidance, and a path.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired arrivals create an access asymmetry, but knowledge as a distinguishing waymark, following as trace-tracking, and guidance as a leader going ahead turn information into a route: the father can repair what did not reach him by moving behind the one it reached.

activation_trace.role: Coming and occurring makes the knowledge an arrival to the speaker rather than an inherited rank.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive content that reached one party.
A distinguishing mark that points toward something makes the received knowledge function as a waymark.
An affair's point of access and readiness defines what the father presently lacks.
Tracking trace after trace supplies the executable means of crossing the access gap.
A guide who goes ahead turns the speaker into the moving front of the route.
The straight road gives the transfer a traversable destination and shape.

changed_reading.before: The son possesses information the father lacks and therefore offers instruction.
changed_reading.after: What arrived to the son becomes a waymark and a traversable repair for the father's missing access; following the bearer is part of how the knowledge is received.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The affectionate father-address followed by the imperative to follow the son and the promise of gentle guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fatherhood's nurturing relation and its marked address remain in place while expertise reverses who leads. Gentle direction and the path's balanced, just quality keep the reversal from erasing filial regard or becoming a claim to replace the father.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and nurturing preserve the senior kinship relation within which the reversal occurs.
The special father-address makes tenderness and continued recognition audible in the appeal.
Following a person or command reverses the expected direction of authority from father to son.
Gentle indication toward road and truth qualifies the son's leadership as guidance rather than domination.
A middle, just, and equitable place gives the offered path a relationally balanced quality.

changed_reading.before: A better-informed son asks his father to submit to a reversal of authority.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a bounded role reversal: the son leads because of received access while his address, manner, and destination continue to honor the father as father.

context_deltas.mechanism: The framing roots place the private arrival of knowledge inside recollection, writing, truthful speech, and prophetic reporting. The focus claim therefore reads as one interpersonal relay of knowledge already made publicly recallable rather than as an isolated assertion of superiority.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower is the focus claim that the framing context reclassifies.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the act by which the exchange is preserved and reactivated.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a durable public carrier for the remembered exchange.
Truthful speech credentials the speaker's report without making seniority its warrant.
The one who reports from God situates the son's received knowledge within transmitted message.

structural_cues: 19:41 places the coming speech inside an imperative to remember it in the book and immediately describes its speaker as truthful and prophetic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an archived frame and truth-prophecy labels; I infer that they convert the private arrival in 19:43 into transmissible testimony. Alternatively, they credential Abraham generally without functioning as evidence inside the father-son exchange.

changed_reading.before: The knowledge asymmetry is a private claim made by one family member to another.
changed_reading.after: The private claim is a relay point in remembered, written, truth-credentialed transmission, so its authority rests on received and conveyable knowledge rather than age.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding contrast with worship directed toward what cannot hear, see, or avail makes the imperative to follow more than a competing demand for submission. It asks for discriminating responsiveness to a bearer who can disclose and guide, where hearing can become understanding and compliance and sight can become inward discernment.

activation_trace.role: Following a person or command is the requested response that the preceding diagnostic tests.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the positive capacity absent from the objects just challenged.
Submissive worship supplies the rival following relation against which the focus imperative is heard.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns receptivity into an accountable response rather than mere sound reception.
Insight of the heart supplies the discernment by which a guide may be distinguished from an inert object.
Sufficiency and effective benefit supply the practical capacity the worshipped objects lack.

structural_cues: 19:42 chains three negated capacities after questioning worship; 19:43 answers with knowledge, following, and guidance in a positive causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incapacity on one side and knowledgeable guidance on the other; I infer that the adjacency makes following a tested response to effective guidance, not blind substitution of authorities. Alternatively, 19:42 may remain only a polemical preface and 19:43 a separate appeal.

changed_reading.before: Follow me because I know something you do not.
changed_reading.after: Shift your responsive allegiance after testing the rival capacities: inert worship neither perceives nor helps, while received knowledge can disclose a path and guide movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following organizes proximity. The even path's rectitude is sharpened by satanic distance and crooked opposition, disobedience as departure from obedience, mercy as tender protection, and wali as close affiliation. The promised path thus changes not only location but whom the father comes to stand beside.

activation_trace.role: Following supplies the chosen relation by which direction and affiliation are enacted.
Rectitude and completion in the thing supply the path's opposed geometry.
Opposition, crookedness, and severity supply the contrary trajectory from which the even path turns away.
Tender mercy makes the warning and invitation protective rather than merely factional.
Departure from obedience identifies the counter-path as an enacted break in alignment.
Nearness without an interval renders the feared outcome as arrival into the wrong proximity.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from worship of the distant, crooked rebel to feared contact with punishment and finally to becoming that rebel's wali.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rectitude, crooked opposition, disobedience, mercy, and close affiliation; I infer a directional arrow from following to eventual proximity. A live alternative is that the warning lists consequences of separate acts without defining the focus path relationally.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is chiefly a correct route or doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The path is an allegiance trajectory: following reorders proximity, drawing the father away from crooked rebellion and toward a mercy-shaped alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the offered following is refused, the father supplies injurious speech and separation, while the speaker supplies peace, protective forgiveness, and then withdrawal. The even path is thereby enacted as a noncoercive route through conflict: invitation can fail without guidance turning into force.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth establishes the manner later tested by rejection.
A just, balanced place supplies the norm governing the speaker's exit from conflict.
Injurious words figured as thrown stones supply the coercive counter-manner to gentle guidance.
Severance and parting supply the rejection imposed by the father.
Peace-making opposed to war supplies the son's immediate answer to threatened injury.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from its effect turns separation into continued solicitude.
Moving aside into a separate quarter supplies the nonviolent completion of the refused invitation.

structural_cues: 19:46-48 form a response sequence: threat and expulsion, then peace and promised intercession, then actual withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed manners and the response sequence; I infer that the speaker's conduct demonstrates the quality of the path promised in 19:43. Alternatively, the aftermath may show personal forbearance without specifying the semantics of the path.

changed_reading.before: I will direct you to a correct destination if you accept my lead.
changed_reading.after: I offer and model a just way of moving: gentle invitation, peace under threat, protective concern, and withdrawal when consent is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nurturing potential held in the father-address is blocked in the upward father-son relation, then reappears forward after withdrawal as unbought gifts made into prophets and as an honored tongue that carries a message. Guidance can continue through generated kinship and transmissible speech even when the immediate father does not follow.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and nurturing supply the vertical relation whose direction and future are being tested.
An unrequited gift supplies the new descendants that open a forward channel after separation.
Making something assume a state supplies the descendants' installation as prophetic carriers.
Kinship from the womb binds the later gift explicitly to a renewed family relation.
The tongue as delivery of a message makes the new line verbally transmissible beyond the household.
Elevation as honor supplies durable public standing to that transmitted truthful speech.

structural_cues: The father rejects the invitation, Abraham withdraws, and the next two ayat answer with gifted descendants, prophetic making, mercy, and an elevated tongue of truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies narrative succession from withdrawal to gifted descendants and durable speech; I infer a compensatory forward channel for the blocked paternal appeal. Alternatively, the gifts are reward after withdrawal without commenting on the mechanism of 19:43.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an attempt to repair one older family member's missing knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The attempted upward repair is also a hinge in a longer kinship relay: refusal by the father does not stop received guidance from moving forward through descendants and speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular invitation to follow expands into a relay. A later messenger directs his household, the larger group is described as guided, and recited signs produce bodily lowering and tears. Knowledge-guidance is therefore not complete as possession; it propagates through address, succession, recitation, and embodied response.

activation_trace.role: Following a person, command, or trace supplies the first interpersonal link in the relay.
Request and obligation supply the later messenger's active transmission into practice.
The group of nearness and belonging turns guidance into a household relation rather than a solitary possession.
Gentle direction to truth repeats the focus guidance at collective scale.
Following and succession within recitation make voiced signs another carrier that comes after prior guidance.
A visible sign supplies the marked content carried by recitation.
Bodily lowering and humility supply observable alignment after the signs are received.
Tears, grief, and voice supply the affective completion of that embodied response.

structural_cues: 19:55 moves direction into a household practice, while 19:58 moves from divine guidance and selection through recited signs to prostration and weeping.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated guidance, family direction, recitation, and bodily response; I infer a transmission chain that enlarges the singular follow-me. Alternatively, 19:58 summarizes several figures collectively and need not describe the specific operation promised in 19:43.

changed_reading.before: One listener is asked to walk behind one knowledgeable speaker.
changed_reading.after: The invitation is one link in a reproducible relay: guidance enters family practice, passes through recited signs, and becomes visible as bodily and affective alignment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it stacks remote material senses from three focus roots rather than reading their ordinary verbal senses. It remains anchored in the explicit arrival-access-route syntax and in packet branches for gathered water, abundant water, and a directed watercourse. Downstream prose should present it only as a hydrological analogy for transmission, never as the lexical meaning of knowledge or coming here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Knowledge comes to one person, does not come to the other, and is followed by a guided route.

activation_trace.role: Water gathered in a depression supplies the image of knowledge collecting at the person it reached.
Abundant water in a sea or well supplies the material held at that point of arrival.
A watercourse and the directing of its flow supply a way for what did not reach the father to be conveyed.
Tracking one trace after another supplies movement along the proposed channel.
Wide smooth ground supplies a traversable gradient for the material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is a possession that licenses the speaker to instruct.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, knowledge has pooled where it arrived and must be routed onward; following opens the channel by which the father's dry access can be repaired.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant mapped target h-d-d under the source root h-d-y. It remains valid as a contrast, not an equation: the focus inventory supplies both gentle guidance and a quarantined threat-shadow, while 19:46 externalizes injurious speech and expulsion. Downstream prose must say that the split mapping sharpens what guidance is not, never that ahdika means threaten or demolish.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promise ahdika offers guidance whose manner is tested by the father's later threat and command to depart.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the ordinary positive pole of the contrast.
Threat and intimidation in the split mapped root supply a formally adjacent but semantically quarantined shadow.
Rectitude and completion mark the promised route as whole rather than destructive.
Injurious speech like thrown stones gives the threat-shadow an overt contextual form.
Severance and parting show the coercive result opposed to the offered guidance.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and threat are simply different acts in adjacent ayat.
changed_reading.after: The packet's split mapping permits a contained contrast: true guidance opens an intact path, while its rejected, form-adjacent shadow appears outside the focus as threat, injury, and expulsion.

strongest_changes: Received knowledge becomes a waymark and a repairable route of access rather than a rank claim.
Following becomes tested relational alignment, opposed both to inert worship and to crooked, disobedient proximity.
The response to rejection shows the promised even path as a noncoercive manner: peace, protective concern, and withdrawal.
The blocked paternal appeal opens into forward kinship and a broader relay of guidance, recitation, and embodied response.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah holds together intimate role reversal, epistemic transfer, route-making, and preserved care. Context turns that compact invitation into an allegiance test and a transmission hinge, while the water-flow and h-d-d activations remain useful only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from paternal refusal to gifted descendants is reader-supplied; the sequence may instead mark reward without compensation.
The collective relay in 19:58 may illuminate the focus mechanism without being specific to Abraham's promise to his father.
Sawiyyan may foreground straightness, completeness, balance, or a just middle in different models; the packet does not force one.
The hydraulic and threat-shadow readings are branch-backed analogies or contrasts, not direct lexical glosses.

baseline.text: Babacığım! Bana, sana gelmemiş bir bilgi geldi. Bana uy, seni düzgün bir yola ileteyim.

findings.text: Oğula gelen fazla bilgi üstünlük dayatmaz; babalık ilişkisini koruyarak nazikçe yol gösterme sorumluluğu doğurur.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Records the outcome of Ibrahim's separation from his father's idolatry, completing the narrative conflict opened in 19:43.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Identifies revelation as guidance and good news, offering a general basis for knowledge that directs believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Describes Abraham as chosen and guided to a straight path, directly characterizing the speaker and destination of 19:43.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The contrast between capability and ignorance is too general, with no specific guidance or filial appeal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A son addresses his father respectfully while urging obedience to divine command, a meaningful filial-dialogue parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God grants Abraham and his descendants mercy and a truthful reputation after the conflict with his father, continuing the local narrative.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Limits understanding of God's parables to the knowledgeable, but does not develop following or a straight path.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rejecting others' desires is necessary to avoid straying and remain guided, a direct contrast to the father's idol worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Ibrahim's announced separation from his father and idols is the direct continuation when his guidance appeal is rejected.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Uses the same appeal structure: follow me and I will guide you to the way of right conduct.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: States that God taught humanity what it did not know, directly supporting the focus contrast between received and absent knowledge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Concludes that the guided path is God's path, specifying the divine destination behind Ibrahim's straight path.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Aaron's prophetic gift continues the later prophet list but has little specific bearing on 19:43.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Idris is another truthful prophet in the same sequence, supporting the surah's model of prophetic reliability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.note: Abraham opens his dialogue with his father and people by asking what they worship, a parallel entry into the same critique of inherited idolatry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: People justify their religion by saying they found their fathers upon a way and are following their tracks, exposing the inherited-pattern obstacle that Ibrahim confronts in his father.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The same ancestral-following formula recurs as a repeated messenger problem, providing a broader context for 43:24 and 19:43.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Every community receives a messenger calling for worship of God and avoidance of false gods; it generalizes the prophetic task enacted by Ibrahim with his father.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Praises one who submits to God and follows Abraham's creed, connecting following Abraham with monotheistic devotion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God declares His path straight, commands people to follow it, and forbids following other paths; this is among the closest direct parallels to 19:43.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jesus declares that God is his Lord and the people's Lord, commands worship of Him, and calls this a straight path; it is a close local monotheism-and-path parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jesus likewise commands worship of the one Lord and identifies that worship as a straight path, reinforcing the focus ayah's destination.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jesus tells the Children of Israel to worship God as his Lord and theirs; its condemnation of associating partners closely supports Abraham's anti-idolatry appeal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joseph rejects false worship, commands worship of God alone, and calls that the upright religion, a closely analogous prophetic correction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Makes obedience to the messenger the condition for being guided, explicitly supporting the command to follow a divinely instructed guide.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Commands people to follow what was revealed from their Lord rather than other patrons, directly contrasting revelation-led following with idolatrous allegiance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God guides those seeking His approval by the revelation to ways of peace and to a straight path, supporting the revelatory route promised in 19:43.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those who listen to speech and follow its best are identified as people whom God has guided, connecting receptive listening and following with guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God increases the guidance of those already guided, supporting guidance as an ongoing divine process rather than merely a verbal instruction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Later successors neglect prayer and follow desires, a pointed negative continuation of the surah's contrast between prophetic guidance and deviant following.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God increases those who accept guidance in guidance, developing the same local guidance theme beyond Abraham's narrative.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those who follow the unlettered messenger receive light and succeed, providing a broader prophetic model for following a messenger's direction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calling idols to guidance does not make them follow, which further exposes the futility of directing worship toward the objects addressed in 19:42-44.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God brings believers from darkness into light while false patrons lead disbelievers into darkness, a theological contrast relevant to Abraham's call away from idols.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (19:41-58) - Guidance as Tracked and Truthful Transmission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Guidance succeeds when a reliable message is marked, carried, followed, and fulfilled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance becomes a road-marker system, prophecy a clear road, and truthful reputation a durable public transmission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Waymarks, leading edge, and followed tracks
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A guide supplies visible markers, takes the leading position, and asks another traveler to follow a traceable route.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: knowledge and recognition (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); road-mark, banner, or boundary marker (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); gentle direction to a road (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); leading edge or advance guide (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); following a person or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); searching footprint after footprint (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); straight road (`quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`); prophecy as a clear, easy road (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Abraham's offer of knowledge is a navigation system: knowledge marks the route, the guide occupies its front edge, and following proceeds trace by trace. The road sense of prophecy makes the later prophetic sequence a continuation of the same marked way.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (19:41-58) - Waterworks of Knowledge and Gift
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Valuable provision is gathered in a bounded reservoir and made accessible through a lifting mechanism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Knowledge, gift, calling, and elevation assemble a reservoir, well head, rope, counterweight, handle, and bucket.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reservoir and rock basin
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water collects in a protected depression or stone basin until it becomes an abundant source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: large water basin (`quranic:root_000220:B002/m01`); water collecting in a depression or around a fort (`quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`); deep source full of water (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); rain pool held in rock (`quranic:root_001685:B003/m01`); abundant gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The abstract arrival of knowledge and gift is materialized as stored water. A depression receives flow, stone holds it, and abundance turns the enclosed pool into a source that can be approached and drawn from.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi babayı, babalık ilişkisini ve ebeveyn gibi besleyip yetiştirmeyi aynı anlam alanında toplar; ayrıca bir şeyin ortaya çıkmasına, düzelmesine veya görünür olmasına sebep olan kimseye yönelik genişletilmiş kullanımı açıkça belirtir. Bu nedenle verilen çerçeve, çekirdek ile ona bağlı genişlemeyi koruduğu sürece kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Babalık çekirdeği, besleyip yetiştirme eylemi ve sebep ya da kaynak sayılma genişlemesi birbirinden ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hem baba ve babalık bildiren yalın biçimleri hem de yalnız belirli yapılarda görülen besleme, baba olma ve baba edinme kullanımlarını ayrı yönler olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin baba olması veya baba soyunu temsil etmesi, ebeveyn gibi besleyip yetiştirmesi anlam alanının çekirdeğidir. Bundan hareketle, bir şeyin ortaya çıkmasına, düzelmesine ya da görünür olmasına sebep olan kimse de baba benzeri bir kaynak olarak adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Bir kimsenin baba olması, babalık ilişkisi taşıması veya baba soyunu temsil etmesidir.
Birini ebeveynin çocuğunu beslediği gibi besleyip büyütme ve yetiştirme eylemidir.
Bir şeyin meydana gelmesine, düzelmesine veya görünür hâle gelmesine sebep olan kimsenin baba benzeri kaynak sayılmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesinde baba ve babalık, yalnız soy ilişkisini değil, ebeveyn gibi besleyip yetiştirmeyi de kapsar. Sebep olma ilişkisi üzerinden bir şeyin doğuşuna, düzelmesine veya ortaya çıkmasına kaynaklık eden kimseye kadar genişleyebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi bilme ve gerçeğiyle kavramadır; bildirme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında yenme ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bilgisizliğin karşıtı olan temel zihinsel edinimi, tanımayı ve gerçeğe uygun kavrayışı birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun kavrama çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olay veya gelişme hakkındaki haberin kişinin bilgisine ulaşması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin farkına varma ve ondan bilgi edinme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilginin tekrar ve yönlendirmeyle bir öğrenende yerleşmesini sağlayan öğretim bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin aktarılması ve öğrenende kalıcı bir sonuç oluşturması sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişi arasındaki bilgi sınamasında bir tarafın ötekini yenmesi bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi alanındaki karşılaştırmayı ve üstün gelme sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haberden haberdar etme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında üstün gelme gibi biçime bağlı uzantıları da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri yakın olsa da odak dalın biçime bağlı aktarım ve edinim süreçleri ile komşunun akletme ve hızlı anlama vurgusu karşılıklı değiştirilebilirliği sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi tanıma, gerçeğine uygun kavrama ve bilgi sahibi olma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilginin yokluğu, durumu tanımama veya gerçeğe aykırı bir kanaat bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı zihinsel erişim ekseninin olumlu ve olumsuz uçlarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bilgiye erişmeyi ve kavramayı bildirirken komşu dal bu erişimin bulunmamasını ya da gerçeğin yanlış bilinmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda yalın bilme ve tanıma, bilginin doğru kullanımından bağımsız olarak çekirdekte yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğruyu bulma, yerinde yargı ve bilgiyi isabetli kullanma niteliğini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bilgi sahibi olmayı ve zihinsel kavrayışı paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bilmek tek başına odak dal için yeterli olabilir; komşu dal ise bilginin doğru yargı ve isabetli davranışla birleşmesini öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

concept_gloss.text: ayırt edici ve yol gösterici işaret

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir son zamanın yaklaştığını haber veren gösterge bağlamına özgüdür.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلامة والعلم والراية والجبل والمعلم ومعالم الطريق والحدود وعلم الثوب ورقمه وتعليم الفارس والثوب والقدح والعمامة والحناء إذا جعلت علامة

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح واحد يدل على أثر بالشيء يتميز به عن غيره (maqayis)؛ العلامة وهي معروفة (maqayis)؛ العلم الراية والجمع أعلام (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلم الجبل الطويل والجميع الأعلام (ayn)؛ العلم الجبل (sihah;mufradat)؛ المعلم الأثر يستدل به على الطريق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ علم الثوب ورقمه في أطرافه (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أعلم الفارس إذا كانت له علامة في الحرب (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلام الحناء (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ علمت عمتي أعلمها علما (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların çoğu hayvan bedenindeki renk ve işaretleri ya da ilgisiz özel adları anlatır; aynı kökün bilme ve işaret dalları adlandırma gerekçesini açıklasa da bu dalın yaratılmışlar bütünü sınırını keskinleştirecek bir karşıtlık oluşturmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. Genel yarılma anlamı veya alt dudaktaki bir biçim bozukluğu bu dala dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti özellikle üst dudakta bulunur; genel çatlaklar, alt dudak ve ağız çevresindeki başka eğrilikler kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üst dudak yarığı dalın temelidir; yarıklı kişi veya deve nitelemesi ile üst dudağı yarma eylemi ilgili biçimlere bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Üst dudağı yarık insan veya üst dudak bölgesinde bu belirti bulunan deve, özelliği taşıyan varlık olarak nitelenir.
Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi uygun yönünden ele almak, bir kimseye bir işte uyup razı olmak veya bir şeyin yapılabilir hale gelmesidir. İhtiyacı usulünce ve incelikle yürütme de bu alandaki ayrı bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir işe sonuç alınabilecek uygun yönünden yaklaşılır.
Bir kimseye belirli bir işte uyulur ve onun isteğine razı olunur.
Bir şey kişi için elverişli ve yapılabilir hale gelir.
Bir ihtiyaç uygun yol gözetilerek incelikle yürütülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, uygun yoldan yaklaşma çevresinde uyma, elverişli hale gelme ve ihtiyacı incelikle yürütme kullanımlarını bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.text: uygun yoldan ele almak ve elverişli hale gelmek
concept_gloss.applicability: İşin uygun yönü, kişiler arası uyum veya bir şeyin yapılabilir hale gelişi birlikte temsil edileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uygun yaklaşım, uyum ve elverişlilik eksenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kişi için yapılabilir veya mümkün hale gelmesini anlatan kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin elverişli hale gelişi anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Uygun yönden yaklaşma, kişiye uyma ve ihtiyacı incelikle yürütme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi su için yol açma ve akışı yöneltme eylemlerini, su kanalı adını ve bir açıklamada akışı tutan birikintiyi açıkça içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Su yolu ve akışı kolaylaştırma çekirdektir; akışı tutan odun ya da yaprak birikintisi kaynakça sınırlı bir yan kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Su yolu adı ile suya yol açmayı bildiren kalıp ayrılır; akışı tutan birikinti yalnız biçimin özel kapsamındadır.

concept_map.definition: Suyun akacağı kanal veya suya bir yol açarak akışını kolaylaştırıp yönlendirmedir. Bir kaynakta aynı ad, nehirde birikip suyu tutan odun ve yapraklar için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Su için açılan veya suyu araziye taşıyan bir kanal bulunur.
Suyun akacağı yol kolaylaştırılır ve akış belirli bir yöne çevrilir.
Bir açıklamada nehirdeki odun ve yaprak birikintisinin suyu tutması adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt su kanalı ile suyun akışına yol açma anlamlarını birleştirir; akışı tutan birikinti aynı toplu iddia içindeki sınırlı bir karşı kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.text: su kanalı açmak ve akışı yönlendirmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem suyu taşıyan yol hem de bu yolu açıp akışı kolaylaştırma kavramsal olarak birlikte verileceğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Su kanalı, yol açma ve akışı yönlendirme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyu araziye veya havuza taşıyan somut su yolu adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyu taşıyan kanal anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Akışı kolaylaştırma eylemini ve suyu tutan birikinti kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: su kanalı; suyu tutan odun ve yaprak birikintisi

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynakların tümü, yağmurun düştüğü başka bir yerden yağmur almamış bölgeye ulaşan seli veya kendi yatağında dışarıdan geçip gelen seli tanımlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız belirtilen sel nitelemesine bağlı tutulur ve sözcükten genel bir yalın anlam türetilmez.

facets.statement: Selin suyu yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden gelir.
Sel, kendi yağmurunu almamış bir bölgeye ulaşıp oradan geçer.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yönetime ödenen vergi veya baş vergisini ortak alan olarak verir ve aynı toplu iddia içinde bir kişiye sunulan rüşvet kullanımını da bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yarışın son sınırı, işlek ya da yürünmüş yol, yol kavşağı ve bir evin karşısında veya hizasında olma kullanımlarını açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yol adı, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama aynı biçim ailesindeki ayrı kullanımlardır; biri ötekine indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yol ve son sınır bildiren adlar ile bir evin karşısında bulunmayı bildiren kalıp ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: İşlek veya yürünmüş ana yol, yolların birleştiği yer ya da yarış atlarının koşusunun bittiği son sınırdır. Bir konum kalıbında, bir evin karşısında veya onunla aynı hizada bulunmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: İnsanların kullandığı işlek veya yürünmüş ana yol adlandırılır.
Yolların birleştiği kavşak veya yolun belirgin ana kesimi anlatılır.
Yarış atlarının koşusunun ulaştığı son sınır adlandırılır.
Bir yapı başka bir yapının karşısında veya aynı hizasında bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt yol, kavşak ve yarış sonu anlamlarını; ayrıca yapıların karşı karşıya veya aynı hizada oluşunu bildiren kalıbı bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.text: işlek ana yol, son sınır ve karşı hizası
concept_gloss.applicability: Yol ailesindeki temel adlar ile yarış sonu ve karşıda bulunma kullanımları topluca temsil edileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yol, kavşak, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama kapsamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların yürüdüğü veya yolların birleştiği belirgin yol adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlek ve yürünmüş yol anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yarış sonu ile bir yapının karşısında veya hizasında bulunma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

branches.what_is_ar: الميتاء والميداء: آخر الغاية، والطريق العامر أو المسلوك، ومجتمع الطريق، ومحاذاة الدار

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kalıplarda kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesini; malın yok olmasını; kişinin öldürülüp götürülmesini ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını destekler. Genel olarak gelişin iyi veya kötü olabileceği notu, bu dalın yalnız zararlı kalıplarını genişletmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen zarar ve tehdit kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel gelme eylemi veya her türlü yok oluş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ölüm, hastalık, mal kaybı, yenilgi ve düşman yaklaşması anlamları yalnız kendi kalıplarında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesi; malının yok olması; öldürülüp götürülmesi ya da düşmanın ona yaklaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya uzuv kırılması gibi ağır bir zarara uğrar.

Bir kişi öldürülür, götürülür veya üzerinde üstünlük kurulur.
Düşman kişiye yaklaşır ve tehdit oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, farklı kalıplarda kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve yaklaşan düşman tehdidini sıralar; genel gelişin olumlu da olabileceği ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: felakete uğramak, kaybetmek veya düşmanca ele geçirilmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Kanıttaki farklı zarar kalıplarının ortak olumsuz sonucunu topluca göstermek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve düşman tehdidi kapsamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gibi kişisel zarar anlatan kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin ağır bir zarara uğramasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Mal kaybını, öldürülüp götürülmeyi ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırığa uğramak

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kimsenin yanında ya da arkasında gitmeyi, onun izini sürmeyi ve ayrıca bir buyruğa, örneğe veya öğretiye uymayı aynı temel izleme ilişkisi altında toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu bedensel ve davranışsal yönleri doğru biçimde yansıtır.
